notes.content: [p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/1G8btceBbgeDBrbZUsZk9I/78974a31038772b462225ba5084d8e99/LA_Rimeria_Besieged_Final_1920x1080_EN_CT-000021939.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Heroes of Arkesia,[/h3][p align="start"]A new threat looms over Rimeria. Downtime will begin on September 17 at 1 a.m. PT (8 a.m. UTC) and is expected to last 8 hours.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]This update introduces Assault: Rimeria, the Combat Analyzer, the Honor System, and more. Read on for the full list of new content, events, store offerings, and other changes [url="https://www.playlostark.com/en-us/game/releases/rimeria-besieged"]here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Arkesia.[/p]

notes.title: Team Update - September 2025
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/3bT5EGHStgXsUeK6kjMuii/fc21ef971d6340b7bc4ccc5de63e48c9/LA_Team_Update_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019266.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Heroes of Arkesia, [/p][p align="start"]There’s a lot on the horizon for [i]Lost Ark[/i] in the coming months, so we wanted to do a round-up and talk through a bunch of key initiatives along with some topics we know the community is curious about. Below a recap of the upcoming September Update, you’ll find a section that covers many upcoming projects with some updates and information. This summer has been a wonderful time in Arkesia, and we plan to keep that up with some major projects, big events, and exciting moments throughout the rest of the year.[/p][h2]Rimeria Besieged[/h2][p align="start"]For those who missed Eye On Arkesia or some of our other announcements on social media, here’s a quick recap of how the September “Rimeria Besieged” update is shaping up.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Summary[/b][/p][p align="start"]The September 17 update will include Assault: Rimeria, which includes an event dungeon and end-game raid, the Combat Analyzer feature, the Honor System, multiple events, and an additional batch of QoL (Quality of Life) changes. The full release notes will be available on Tuesday, September 16.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Golden Frog Extension[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’ve seen (most) Relic Engraving prices fall despite higher volumes of sales with the Golden Frog. To help increase the supply of Relic Engravings as we head toward the release of Act 4 and Kazeros, the Golden Frog has been extended through October 15th. We also hope that this will allow time for the new and returning players who have started to finish other progression systems to have a head-start on gathering some Relic Engravings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige Shop Adjustments[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’re planning some ongoing adjustments to the Prestige Shop, where items will rotate in and out. At the end of September, the bound gold offering will be rotated out, and new offerings (such as Pheons and Life Energy/Leap’s Essence) will be rotated in. We will also work to bring over new cosmetic offerings from Korea when available![/p][h2]Upcoming Projects[/h2][p][b]Final 2025 Roadmap[/b][/p][p align="start"]The final roadmap for 2025 will release at the end of September, and will include the content plans for the rest of the year. We’ll give one spoiler since we’ve seen a lot of players asking about it— the balance patch that released alongside Kazeros in Korea will be arriving in October.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Region Merge Policy[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’ve nearly locked-in the full Region Merge policy for NA West and East, and will be sharing in the weeks leading up to the merge in October. While you’ll need to wait for that policy for all the specifics, we are excited to share that we’ve factored in player feedback to the naming policy that we saw coming out of previous region merges— as this was a hot topic and something we’ve seen a lot of questions in the community about. Instead of giving either region priority for names, we created a policy that will reward active players. With the enormous amount of players at launch, there are names sitting idle in each region that would mean active players wouldn’t receive their name after the merge, which didn’t seem fair. Our way of rewarding players who 1) are active, and 2) got the name first, will be the following policy:[/p][list][*][p]The name is granted to the player with highest combat level on their roster (ie. a player who has played since the launch of Tier 4 with a lvl. 70 character will receive the name over a roster with a lvl. 60 character from launch).[/p][/*][*][p]If both names have the same highest level character on the roster (ie. both lvl. 70), the name will be granted to the player who first created the name.[/p][/*][*][p]Guild names will be granted to whichever guild was created first.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We know that there are many more questions, but wanted to give a little spoiler as we’ve seen many players asking about the naming policy. Once again, we will share all the policy specifics and information on the technical side of the merge as soon as possible as we continue planning and preparing for the merge in October.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kazeros The First Plans[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’ve seen some requests for information on the plans and policies for Kazeros’ release in the West, and wanted to acknowledge. We’ve begun work on the plans and for releasing Kazeros, and the policies for the first clear race in the Western version of Lost Ark. We’ll share some specifics in the upcoming roadmap, and others will be shared closer to the release of the raid once they’re locked in. We understand the importance of this to the hardcore raiding community however, and will work to share information as soon as we’re able to.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Paradise / Azena’s Blessing[/b][/p][p]We wanted to provide a quick note that in the downtime between Paradise seasons that Azena’s Blessing will not provide +1 Elysian Entry Tickets (as the content will not be accessible). It has been fun witnessing the journey through the various stages of Paradise, and seeing players encounter new challenges now that all 10 stages are unlocked. We wish you luck in the rest of the season!
[/p][p][b]Mokoko Bootcamp Improvements[/b][/p][p align="start"]First— a quick note to the many new and returning players who have began or resumed adventures in Arkesia this summer— Thank you Mokokos! It has been a lot of fun watching your journeys unfold as you progress, explore, and learn. We appreciate the passion and support and have been listening to your feedback on the events and your experience in the game and will be using it to help inform future progression events for future players just like yourselves. We’ve also been listening to veteran player feedback on the Mokoko Bootcamp event, and plan to use this to help inform changes to the next iteration of the event. As we previously shared, for the next Mokoko Bootcamp there will be a contest to create a special icon and title chosen by the community. As these events are built to promote community cohesion, we thought it may be fun to get the community more involved in the title and icon process heading forward. For future Mokoko Bootcamps, we’re going to run a title and icon contest to put the power in the hands of the community to decide what you want. We didn’t want every title to follow the same bootcamp theme and lose their value, so we thought this could be a fun way for veteran players to choose their reward, and make the title more of a “chase” item. We’ll continue to discuss this topic and share plans as the current event draws to a close and we prepare for the next iteration. We’ll be on the lookout for any feedback throughout this period, and thank you for everything you’ve provided so far![/p][p][/p][p][b]Team Survey[/b][/p][p align="start"]Our next survey is planned for later this month. The feedback we received in the last one was instrumental in helping make updates to Lost Ark, such as the restructuring of Una’s Tasks, and helping inform the development of Paradise— and we’d love to hear how your experience is going once again! Be on the lookout in the coming weeks.[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued feedback and support, and we’ll be back with more updates and key communications on a variety of these topics in the near future! We’ll see you soon with the September release notes, next player survey, roadmap, merge information and more![/p]

notes.title: Rise of the Valkyrie Release Notes
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/VsG4T3GIvcjaCGrW5VuhG/2b298d968a9847c6c889056f4bb5e90d/LA_Rise_of_the_Valkyrie_-_August_Key_Art_Final_1920x1080_EN_CT-000021293.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Heroes of Arkesia,[/h3][p][/p][p]The Valkyrie is about to descend upon Arkesia. Downtime will begin on August 20 at 2 a.m. PT (9:00 a.m. UTC) and is expected to last 4 hours.[/p][p][/p][p]This update introduces the new Valkyrie class, Trust Point System, Ebony Cube changes, two new progression events, the return of the Golden Frog, Prestige Shop and more. Check out the full list of new content, events, store offerings, and other changes [url="https://www.playlostark.com/en-us/game/releases/rise-of-the-valkyrie"]here[/url]. Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Arkesia![/p]

notes.title: Team Update - August 2025
notes.content: [h2][/h2][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/3bT5EGHStgXsUeK6kjMuii/fc21ef971d6340b7bc4ccc5de63e48c9/LA_Team_Update_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019266.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We wanted to share some key information leading up to the August “Rise of the Valkyrie” Update, as we’ve locked in some policies and key changes we know you’ve been looking forward to! It’s been a fun few weeks watching players learn the new Paradise system, progress through the Mokoko Challenge Express, and help new and returning players learn the ropes. The August Update, featuring the Valkyrie Class, will also include a ton of other impactful updates. As always, some things may shift during ongoing development— make sure to checkout next week’s release notes for the final August details.[/p][p][/p][h2]Major August Update - Rise of the Valkyrie[/h2][p][/p][h3]Bonus Powerpass[/h3][p]In the August Update, we will also be granting all players an additional South Kurzan Powerpass! We saw an enormous amount of new and returning players begin or resume their adventures in Arkesia with the July Update, and want to provide a little boost to help them build out their roster or try out new classes/playstyles. No worries if you haven’t used the first one yet, they will stack.[/p][p][/p][h3]Rise of the Valkyrie Event[/h3][p]Heading toward the update, we wanted to share some topline information to help players best plan out how they plan to use the latest “road/path” style event. It can be paired with the Mokoko Challenge Express, or activated on another character. Key details:[/p][list][*][p]Event Target Item Level: 1640 – below 1681 can start the event.[/p][/*][*][p]Honing Support Effects will be provided from Item Level 1660 to 1680.[/p][/*][*][p]Item Level Rewards will be provided for 1640, 1650, 1660, 1670 and 1680.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can earn the Item Level 1680 complete rewards and the chest will contain the 1690 and 1700 Rewards chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Challenge missions will include clearing Aegir and Brelshaza.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards will include an assortment of Honing Materials and other Progression Materials. One notable reward will be four bound Tier 4 Lv. 7 Gems![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Ebony Cube Update Policy[/h3][p]As previously shared, In the August Update, we’re going to make a change to Ebony cube and how it interacts with Paradise. This change will double the rewards provided by Ebony Cube, but reduce the Cube Ticket drop rate by 50% (in all places, including the guild shop and dispatches). We think this change will make Ebony Cube more exciting to play, and will also help decrease the amount of homework content with the addition of Paradise. As some players have massive stockpiles of tickets, and others have been dutifully running cubes whenever they get a ticket, 2 tickets will combine into one ticket (with the new doubled rewards) when the update takes place to maintain a fair balance for all players. This will work in the following ways:[/p][list][*][p]Players with Cube tickets in their inventories will have the tickets automatically converted.[/p][/*][*][p]Cube Selection Chests (across the roster in various storages) will be converted as well.[/p][/*][/list][p]The full policy will be shared in the release notes. Please note that the cube changes only apply to Tier 4.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, we will also be adding the ability to convert Ebony Cube Tickets into Hell Keys through the Paradise Exchange Vendor. Each exchange can be done on each character once a week, due to large stacks of cube tickets that currently exist in the wild that would disproportionally favor some players.[/p][list][*][p]T4 (1640) Rare Hell Key x1[/p][list][*][p]Cost - Ebony Cube 1st Unlock x2[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]T4 (1640) Epic Hell Key x1[/p][list][*][p]Cost - Ebony Cube 1st Unlock x3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]T4 (1640) Legendary Hell Key x1[/p][list][*][p]Cost - Ebony Cube 1st Unlock x5[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]T4 (1680) Rare Hell Key x1[/p][list][*][p]Cost - Ebony Cube 2nd Unlock x2[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]T4 (1680) Epic Hell Key x1[/p][list][*][p]Cost - Ebony Cube 2nd Unlock x3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]T4 (1680) Legendary Hell Key x1[/p][list][*][p]Cost - Ebony Cube 2nd Unlock x5[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]T4 (1680) Epic Hell Key x1[/p][list][*][p]Cost - Ebony Cube 3rd Unlock x2[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]T4 (1680) Legendary Hell Key x1[/p][list][*][p]Cost - Ebony Cube 3rd Unlock x4[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Tier 3 Update[/h3][p]To ensure that players in Tier 3 can be competitive in the weekly Crucible rankings, and for new players/returning players building characters and learning new playstyles, we’re going to move the Hyper Awakening and Hyper Awakening Skills (T-Skills) to unlock in Tier 3. Full details of how this will be unlocked in Tier 3 will be available in next week’s release notes![/p][p][/p][p]With the Valkyrie Advanced Class, new skins, further support class balance changes and much more— the August Update will include a ton of content and impactful changes for all. The full release notes will be available before the update next week! In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia.[/p]

notes.title: Team Update - July Update Commentary
notes.content:
[p]Heroes of Arkesia,[/p][p]With the “Welcome to Paradise” Release Notes now live, there were a few additional topics we wanted to discuss and provide a short update on!
[/p][p][b]Future of Ebony Cube[/b][/p][p]In the August Update, we’re going to make a change to Ebony cube and how it interacts with Paradise. This change will double the rewards provided by Ebony Cube, but reduce the Cube Ticket drop rate by 50% (in all places, including the guild shop and dispatches). We think this change will make Ebony Cube more exciting to play, and will also help decrease the amount of homework content with the addition of Paradise. Please note; as some players have massive stockpiles of tickets, and others have been dutifully running cubes whenever they get a ticket, 2 tickets will combine into one ticket (with the new doubled rewards) when the update takes place to maintain a fair balance for all players.

Additionally, when this update takes place, we will also be adding the ability to convert Ebony Cube Tickets into Hell Keys through the Paradise Exchange Vendor. There are still some things up in the air that we’re considering, how it will work with different level cube tickets, whether or not there will be weekly exchange limits and other details— but we wanted to provide as early of a notice as possible to maintain transparency, in case players who normally run all their cubes want to save up a few. We’ll be doing a follow-up team update when once we get some of those of details fully locked in!
[/p][p][b]August Road/Path Event[/b][/p][p]Similarly, we’re still working to tune the details of the upcoming road/path style progression event arriving alongside the Valkyrie, but will provide an update as soon as we finalize the details on the types of rewards, along with the Item Level requirements. 
[/p][p][b]2025 Swimsuit Skins[/b][/p][p]Summer is definitely heating up in Arkesia. Showing off the full line of swimsuit skins would’ve required us to add an age-gate to the website— but don’t worry, they’ll all be in-game tomorrow! You’ll be able to preview and see the full collection in the in-game store. 

If you haven’t seen the full Welcome to Paradise Release Notes, make sure to check out the massive amount of new content, updates, events, and more arriving in Arkesia this week! We’ll see you in Paradise. And Hell. We wish you luck in your adventures through all the new content!
[/p]

notes.content: [p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/QczP89LLDtP1S7cnK0htl/a52b64f21bd6d02ae2d0f56761d3a617/LA_Welcome_To_Paradise_-_Paradise_Final_1920x1080_EN_CT-000020221.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Heroes of Arkesia,[/h3][p][/p][p]The gates to Paradise are nearly open. Downtime will begin on July 23 at 1 a.m. PT (9 a.m. UTC) and is expected to last 10 hours.[/p][p][/p][p]This update introduces the new Paradise progression system, including Elysian, Crucible, and Hell, plus Aegir Solo, solo mode improvements, quality of life changes, and system updates. Rounding off the release is the return of Mokoko Bootcamp.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the full list of new content, events, store offerings, and other changes [url="https://www.playlostark.com/game/releases/welcome-to-paradise"]here[/url]. Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Arkesia![/p]

notes.title: Team Update - Awaiting Paradise
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/3bT5EGHStgXsUeK6kjMuii/fc21ef971d6340b7bc4ccc5de63e48c9/LA_Team_Update_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019266.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Heroes of Arkesia,[/h3][p][/p][p]Next week’s release notes are shaping up to be the longest set of notes on record. Before those drop, we had a few topics we wanted to discuss in a setting outside of the release notes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Event Reminder[/h2][p]Before we dive in, here’s a quick reminder from our previous Team Update. With the player-requested change to have the progression events release in July alongside the Paradise Update, players interested in making the Valkyrie Advanced Class will need to wait to activate the progression events. The events will still be live for several months after the release of the class— plenty of time to progress and unlock all the benefits offered by the Mokoko Challenge Express.[/p][p][/p][p]To coincide with the Summer Player Gift, we will also be sending the Legendary Skin gift to all players with the July update! Players who want to use the Legendary Skin on the Valkyrie Advanced Class will be able to hold it until the class releases. Once again, we think this will be a net benefit for all players. The timing won’t change for Valkyrie enthusiasts, but sometimes patience can be more difficult when the shiny skins are sitting in your inventory. We wish you luck![/p][p][/p][h3]Mokoko Bootcamp[/h3][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/7yB0ldaz5LKmKUfRa4VjLM/16e24248a55380e6ded14a6e5cc7190a/LA_Thaemine_Discord_Mokoko_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Mokoko Bootcamp will be releasing with a variety of changes built to help players organically progress and learn, and will be running until October. We hope to continually improve the system, and will be on the lookout for additional feedback to ensure that this community-centric event is accomplishing the goals of breaking down gate-keeping barriers and making helping others a fun time for all. To fit that theme, the title for this version of the Mokoko Bootcamp will be “Mokoko Gatesmasher”, accompanied with a title icon of a hammer.[/p][p][/p][p]As these events are built to promote community cohesion, we thought it may be fun to get the community more involved in the title and icon process heading forward. For future Mokoko Bootcamps, we’re going to run a title and icon contest to put the power in the hands of the community to decide what you want. We didn’t want every title to follow the same bootcamp theme and lose their value, so we thought this could be a fun way for veteran players to choose their reward. We’ll follow up with more details (and contest rules) as we head toward the next Bootcamp, but wanted to share our idea so people could begin brainstorming alongside any other feedback they have on the event![/p][p][/p][h3]Gold Adjustments[/h3][p]With Paradise introducing vast new quantities of progression materials (including fusion materials and character bound gold), and the progression event providing everything a new player could need (from max cards to entry level accessories), we are introducing some gold changes for endgame content to better balance rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Our goal with the changes was to prevent alternate rosters from farming too much gold that could be moved to other rosters/accounts, while ensuring that players in those levels weren’t impacted heavily. Some solo modes have had their gold increased, some other raids will see decreases, and a few just have changes to the balance of bound gold vs. unbound gold. For example, the highest level raid adjusted was Aegir (Normal), with no changes in total gold, but with a rebalance to move some gold into bound gold. Additionally, the bonus item boxes (view more rewards) that can be purchased after each gate have been decreased in price for many raids (up to Aegir Hard Mode) to reward players who are looking to continue to progress their characters.[/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/10mso7kpFKhWqxGLm0yDsr/6de6908d60144b122c4db32e8a289aad/LA_Aegir_Release_Note_Images_C_v01_1080.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]We wanted to share this update ahead of time, and explain the reasons in a place outside of the release notes— since they’re over 23,000 words total! There’s a lot of other things that will be covered in those notes early next week, including the full number changes for raids with changed reward prices and changed total gold amounts.[/p][p][/p][p]Bonus note— to help players who want to work on their roster as a whole, we have pivoted the character bound gold in the Mokoko Challenge Express event to be roster bound gold.[/p][p][/p][h2]Market Discussions[/h2][p][/p][h3]Bound Gems[/h3][p]As previously announced, the July update will introduce the Luminous Gem system into the Western version of Lost Ark. Our region’s player to player market was more resilient than other regions, and the price of level 10 damage gems today have barely decreased from their price when the original announcement was shared in Korea. As level 10 damage gems have retained nearly all of their value and they will still be fully usable by their owners, the compensation sent out in some other regions of Lost Ark will not be distributed in the Western version.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited for the new and fun customization opportunities that the Luminous Gem system will provide for all players, with greater freedom to try out new builds, and that the new T4 Luminous Gems in the Solo Shop help new and returning players gear up for the challenges that await them in the war against Kazeros.[/p][p][/p][h3]Sidereal Energy[/h3][p]Similarly, our region didn’t experience major price fluctuations for Sidereal Energy when Elgic Infuse II was introduced, so the compensation sent out in KR won’t be distributed. However, we will be awarding an exclusive Relic icon title and class symbol in the July update to those who have completed Elgic Infuse II.
[/p][hr][/hr][p]The July ‘Welcome to Paradise’ update arrives next week on July 23! As normal, the release notes will be available the day before, covering the massive amount of changes arriving in this update. We’ll see you in Paradise, next week![/p]

notes.title: Team Update - July 2025
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704661/eb39a4fc4dcaa91bb784f92d277fcadb2127f46a.png"][/img][/p][p]Heroes of Arkesia,[/p][p]We've shared several exciting announcements through LOA ON and our recent [url="https://www.playlostark.com/en-us/news/articles/2025-roadmap-part-3"]Roadmap Part 3 article[/url]. While we've worked to provide comprehensive details in our updates, there are additional topics the community has been discussing that we'd like to address and offer more clarity.[/p][p][/p][h3]Style Book and Stronghold Portrait Policy[/h3][p][/p][p]First off, we’ve seen some confusion in the community regarding moderation of style book and portrait uploads. Anything that is merely showing off an in-game character in their skins/cosmetics is allowed (including swimwear and other revealing outfits). However, we will be moderating and applying penalties for uploads that attempt to depict sexual acts, character nudity with skin dyes, and other disruptive or harmful content. You can refer to the [url="https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GK4QHHHAC82SQTS8"]Amazon Games Code of Conduct[/url] for further information on what type of content is not tolerated.[/p][p][/p][h2]July Update[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6QJkxDXoVb6jzfv4DX3Nby/f874f45a4eec11bd1216a8b660c83508/LA_MaharakaIsland_6_1080.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Along with everything we already announced for July (Paradise, May/June Balance, UI improvements, Solo Aegir & Solo Rework, Skin Book, Una Overhaul, Gem Updates, Party Finder Lounge, Tripod Level/Epic Engraving simplification), there is a ton more in the update. When we share some of those specifics early in the roadmap, it’s meant to be an early sneak-peek into what’s coming, but not a comprehensive list of everything. [/p][p][/p][p]There is a ton more arriving in July, so here’s a few more selected spoilers (which we’ve seen the community asking about) to keep up the excitement before the full release notes with every detail are shared:[/p][list][*][p]Maharaka Festival will be returning.[/p][/*][*][p]You will be able to celebrate in the pools of Maharaka Paradise with the latest swimsuit skins![/p][/*][*][p]The Achievement system overhaul is arriving.[/p][/*][*][p]4 Hairstyles will be added (2 for each base class).[/p][/*][*][p]Beginner Growth Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Guide mission adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Mokoko Buff Extended to 1660.[/p][/*][*][p]Procyon's Protection expanded up to Aegir.[/p][/*][*][p]Gear Crafting requirement reduction.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional QoL surrounding daily activities, including Kurzan Frontline, Guardians, and Una’s Tasks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Progression Event Update[/h3][p][/p][p]We saw a lot of player requests for our team to attempt to move the Valkyrie Advanced Class from August to July. While the class won’t be ready in time, we also saw a lot of requests bubbling up in the community to have the progression events active for players returning or interested in starting their adventure in Arkesia when the massive amount of improvements arrive— so we made the decision to release the Powerpass and Mokoko Challenge Express Event early, in the July Update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/2I37kkw8QgFMybQCemFYsK/40a8f43b7283bc5e30215ef1fb6fabd5/LA_Roadmap_Aug_KeyArt_1920x1080_CT.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This shift means that players interested in making the Valkyrie Advanced Class will need to wait to activate the events, but we think that giving new or returning players the ability to hop right into the action will be a better experience overall. For those who wanted to create a Valkyrie nothing will change, and the events will still be live for several months after the release of the class— plenty of time to progress and unlock all the benefits offered by the Mokoko Challenge Express. We will provide a few more additional notices reminding players to save the events for Valkyrie if they’re planning to use them when the class releases in August.[/p][p][/p][p]We are planning to have an additional event that will release in August, similar to past “road/path” events to further help players progress, or allow players planning on making the Valkyrie Advanced Class to quickly progress.[/p][p][/p][h3]Long Term Projects[/h3][p][/p][p]We are currently targeting this fall (around October) to merge NA West & NA East, so we will have one region for North America and one for Europe. We’ve seen a lot of player feedback both requesting this merge along with questions regarding when it may happen, so we wanted to provide an update. There’s a ton of details that we’ll dive into as we head toward the merge in future team updates along with dedicated policies about the merge, but we wanted to be transparent about when we anticipate this arriving.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/5F7VqzcvxyBAK20VerEbTh/3ae4b806eba416cdbc9b0132520a1923/Raid_Match_02_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This will be a major project requiring a lot of the team’s attention, so we will need to put some other projects on the backburner, including work on the API. We will provide future updates on the API when we’re able, but need to adjust internal resources in the meantime.[/p][p][/p][h2]Looking Ahead[/h2][p][/p][p]While we provided some additional spoilers in this team update, there are still many other changes arriving to make your experience in Arkesia even better in the July Update. We’re excited to see players progress faster with Paradise and major QoL adjustments, and will be on the lookout for feedback as we continually strive to make life in Arkesia the best it can be.[/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate the ongoing support, feedback, and passion from you, the Lost Ark community, and will continue to provide team updates as soon as we’re able. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia![/p]

notes.title: The Lost Ark June update opens up a new island and makes two raids easier
notes.content:
The Lost Ark June update is here, and it introduces a new location to the free-to-play Amazon Games MMORPG, along with some extra story following on from its newest raid. The patch also makes several previous raids easier, with difficulty nerfs and the introduction of a resurrection system, and introduces a style book that helps you manage your character customization. It's the latest in an ongoing series of changes as Amazon attempts to spice things up in an attempt to win players back.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
The best MMO and MMORPGs to play in 2025
Lost Ark Abyssal Assault takes the free MMORPG to an all-new region

notes.title: June Update Release Notes
notes.content: [p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/5ysb5PMIQK72vlAvLIiyDt/a18709a094b7b76e9b686ef05ed8a500/LA_Mythic_Desert_Western_Exclusive_Skins_Images_Mount1_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019361.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Heroes of Arkesia,[/p][p]The June update will arrive June 25th. Downtime will begin at 2:00 a.m. PT / 9:00 a.m. UTC, with an expected downtime of 7 hours. This update introduces Yornujan Island, the new Stylebook and Screenshot Storage systems, and adds Stronghold Frames for displaying screenshots. Major tuning hits Epic and Kazeros Raids, including nerfs and the new Individual Resurrection System. Also, don’t miss the exclusive Mythic Desert Collection—featuring skins, mounts, pets, and more![/p][h2]New Content & Features[/h2][p]Kazeros Raid: Act 3 After Story – Beyond the Dark Fog[/p][p]Dive deeper into the unfolding epic of[i] Lost Ark[/i] with the new after story quest, Beyond the Dark Fog. This narrative continues the saga following Kazeros Raid: Act 3, shedding light on the consequences of Kadan and Guardian Luen’s choices. Witness the first signs of the looming final confrontation with Kazeros as the world teeters on the edge of darkness.[/p][list][*][p]Quest Start Location:[/p][list][*][p]Speak with Shandi’s Illusory Bird in Seuht Valley.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Requirements:[/p][list][*][p]Complete the Rimeria World Quest: The Mission Continues[/p][/*][*][p]Complete the Kazeros Raid: Act 3 Prelude Quest: As One Again[/p][/*][*][p]Achieve Achievement Level 1 by defeating Mordum on any difficulty[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Yornujan Island[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6VL4WuwNjNrmvRiMdkxuG5/bb73a053bd8f4c0d28ace1999aa65286/Yornujan_Island.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Yornujan Island has surfaced—set sail now! This mysterious new island off the coast of Rimeria is home to young Yoz honing their illusion skills, and they need your help. Dive into a captivating story, take on a new daily quest, and earn valuable rewards—including the coveted Island Soul.[/p][list][*][p]Quest Progression[/p][list][*][p]Begin the Main Quest by interacting with the “Poorly Made Illusory Horse” near the island’s beach. The recommended Item Level is 1640 or above.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock the Adventure Quest: In Search of the Legendary Illusion.[/p][/*][*][p]After completing Instructor and Trainee, start the General Quest: Path of an Instructor Chapter 1: Advice and Encouragement.[/p][/*][*][p]The island’s Daily Quest becomes available after completing Path of an Instructor Chapter 3: Adaptive Explanation.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Daily Quest Rewards[/p][list][*][p]Earn Rainbow Corn from the Daily Quest, which can be exchanged for various roster-bound items via the Rainbow Corn Exchange.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can also earn:[/p][list][*][p]Honing materials[/p][/*][*][p]Transcendence Restoration tickets[/p][/*][*][p]Rare/Uncommon card selection pack[/p][/*][*][p]High seas coin and Structure[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Additional Content[/p][list][*][p]5 new Mokoko Seeds[/p][/*][*][p]The Yornujan Island Soul[/p][/*][*][p]3 new Achievements and 1 Title[/p][/*][*][p]A new Music Sheet[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Stylebook[/p][p]The new Stylebook system is giving players access to shared styles, screenshots, and appearance presets. With improved integration into character creation, reskin, and Selfie Mode, customizing your character has never been more expressive—or more shareable. Whether you want to showcase your look or save your favorite fashion inspirations, this system makes styling easier and more social than ever.[/p][list][*][p]Added the Stylebook System and its related selfie mode features[/p][/*][*][p]Styles are registered on an account basis (max 40 styles)[/p][/*][*][p]The Stylebook UI can be opened while in character creation and Reskin[/p][/*][*][p]Styles can be clicked to find out more in-depth details about that style[/p][/*][*][p]A style set to "Allow Saving Appearance" can be saved to the customization preset[/p][/*][*][p]A style set to "Set Skin Info to Public" displays the relevant skin information[/p][/*][*][p]Styles will now be features on the Style Home tab:[/p][list][*][p]Hot Style: The styles that adventurers are paying attention to recently[/p][/*][*][p]How about this style: 8 styles registered in the style book that are randomly selected[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players' favorite style can now be liked by using the 'recommendation' button once and cannot be canceled[/p][/*][*][p]Styles registered as favorites can checked through the 'View Favorite Only' option (Max 40 Favorites)[/p][/*][*][p]Styles registered by other players can be viewed in the Full View tab[/p][/*][*][p]Players can view, modify, or delete registered style information in the My Style tab[/p][/*][*][p]Styles can now be registered by selecting 'Register Style' at the bottom right of the Stylebook[/p][list][*][p]Players can apply screenshots from the screenshot storage by clicking the apply button in[/p][p]the Registration Style window[/p][/*][*][p]Players will need to add at least one screenshot (max 3)[/p][list][*][p]The appearance information is saved when players activate the "Save Character's Appearance Information When Taking Photo" option in Selfie Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Temporary screenshots are not eligible for style registration[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The first screenshot must register the screenshot with the appearance information[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shared customization information can be saved by other players in their presets[/p][/*][*][p]The 'Set Skin Info to Public' option allows the skin information, when the screenshot was taken, to be shared with the style[/p][/*][/list][p]Screenshot Storage[/p][p]The new Screenshot Storage system helps players manage their in-game photography by separating temporary and saved screenshots. With support for up to 80 temporary and 40 permanent images, along with new expiration and recovery options, managing your memories is easier and more flexible than ever.[/p][list][*][p]Screenshots and selfies taken while playing are saved as 'temporary screenshots'[/p][list][*][p]Up to 80 temporary screenshots can be saved[/p][/*][*][p]Temporary screenshots will be removed at the end of the session. Players must move screenshots to the screenshot storage to save them permanently (max 40)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Screenshots in the storage box are saved for up to 90 days[/p][list][*][p]If the “Fix It” button is selected the screenshot will be saved past the 90 days[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Stronghold Frame Structure[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/5l1uKGS3jF4g0FgnDLj4aH/bfded8b5fbdf95d3c005bb5b261d5f5f/LA_June_Update_Screenshots_Stylebook_UI_04_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019360.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Show off your best moments with the new Frame feature in your Stronghold. Players can place and display their favorite screenshots, adjust brightness, and create curated visual spaces that reflect their adventures across Arkesia.[/p][list][*][p]Added "Frame" feature where players can exhibit their screenshots[/p][/*][*][p]Interacting with the placed Frame causes the Screenshot Apply UI to be opened[/p][/*][*][p]If players retrieve a Frame with a screenshot, the information applied to the frame will not be saved[/p][list][*][p]The information is maintained when storing the batch preset in the Stronghold[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players can adjust brightness between 1 - 5 stages[/p][/*][*][p]Setting the 'Maintain Default Brightness Without Being Affected by Ambient Light and Shadows' option will cause the screenshot to not be affected by lighting changes in the stronghold[/p][/*][/list][h2]Raid Adjustments[/h2][p]Frontier Title Reward Update[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/5NKbjIBvZ3rTNbJkfpc3f8/7a9ff158c84e0b79f263d4d2ebddfb81/LA_Roadmap_JAN_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Players who clear Explorer or Pathfinder difficulty in Kazeros Raid: Act 2 and Act 3 will now receive the corresponding lower-tier Frontier titles along with higher-tier ones.[/p][/*][*][p]This change ensures players automatically earn all relevant titles when completing higher difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]Based on the player poll we released, we’ve also updated the “Thunderbolt Master” title name to “Lord of Thunder.”[/p][/*][/list][p]Kazeros Raid Resurrection System[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/10mso7kpFKhWqxGLm0yDsr/6de6908d60144b122c4db32e8a289aad/LA_Aegir_Release_Note_Images_C_v01_1080.jpeg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Kazeros Raids now feature an Individual Resurrection System. This replaces instant death with a tactical revival window, allowing players a chance to return using a Phoenix Plume. It can be used once per gate, but won’t save you from certain mechanics or prevent a full wipe. MVP and achievement conditions have also been adjusted to reflect this change.[/p][list][*][p]Added the Individual Resurrection System to Kazeros Raids (Normal and Hard difficulties)[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced instant death with a death delay state during boss fights[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled players to manually resurrect during death delay using the “Resurrect Now” button[/p][list][*][p]Limited resurrection use to once per character per gate[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Blocked additional resurrection if the player dies again after using their one resurrection[/p][/*][*][p]Resurrection eligibility resets when restarting a gate[/p][/*][*][p]A Phoenix Plume is now required to use “Resurrect Now”[/p][list][*][p]Made Phoenix Plumes exchangeable for Adventurer’s Seals or Jelly Cookies at the Stronghold[/p][/*][*][p]Added Phoenix Plumes to reward pools for newly introduced weekly Una’s Tasks[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players will have a forced death if they do not choose to resurrect before the delay timer ends[/p][list][*][p]Excluded certain boss mechanics from the death delay, causing instant death instead[/p][/*][*][p]Restricted resurrection to cases where at least one party member is still alive[/p][/*][*][p]Raid failure is now triggered if all members are either dead or in death delay[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Full HP and temporary invincibility are granted when resurrecting from the death delay state[/p][/*][*][p]All skill cooldowns are maintained as they were before death[/p][/*][*][p]Character-specific gauges (e.g., temperature, electricity) are preserved during death delay[/p][/*][*][p]Players will respawn at their point of death, unless in invalid terrain (in which case they are moved to a valid location)[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled Allied Forces Skills while the raid leader is in the death delay state[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented raids from earning the “Untouchable Raid” achievement if any member enters death delay[/p][/*][*][p]Removed eligibility for the “Last One Standing” MVP if any member is in death delay when the raid is cleared[/p][/*][*][p]Disallowed spectating of characters who are in death delay[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled Phoenix Plume use directly from Currency Storage while dead or in death delay[/p][/*][/list][p]Raid Nerf: Epic Raid and Kazeros Raid Act 0 - 2[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6YlnlVnHGZw8EUJjasK4jd/538397d16fbebeb111dff03b3020172d/LA_Roadmap_June_KeyArt_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Major tuning has been applied across multiple Gates in the Epic and Kazeros Raids, including reduced boss HP, toned-down patterns, and cleaner gameplay moments for both Normal and Hard difficulties. These changes aim to smooth out difficulty spikes while preserving each encounter’s intended challenge and mechanics.[/p][list][*][p]Epic Raid[/p][list][*][p]Gate 1[/p][list][*][p]Reduced damage and debuff effects of certain patterns used by Behemoth[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the damage of certain patterns used by the Guardian of Chaos[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased the hitbox size of whirlwinds fired around Behemoth during a specific pattern[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gate 2[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the damage of certain patterns used by Behemoth[/p][/*][*][p]During the pattern where Behemoth summons two whirlwinds that deal AoE damage, the number of damaging whirlwinds has been reduced[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Kazeros Raid: Act 0[/p][list][*][p]Gate 1[/p][list][*][p]Removed some Status Ailment Resistance from non-boss monsters and reduced their damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gate 2[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the damage of flower attacks launched by Echidna[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased the movement speed of the snakes that approach Echidna during the penalty gauge phase at the underground[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Kazeros Raid: Act 1[/p][list][*][p]Normal and Hard Difficulty[/p][list][*][p]Gate 1[/p][list][*][p]During the pattern where Akkan, King of Death opens a path to the land of the dead with his scythe, players will no longer take damage when hit by the scythe[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Normal Difficulty[/p][list][*][p]Gate 1[/p][list][*][p]Reduced damage and Push immunity effects from certain patterns during the battle[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gate 2[/p][list][*][p]Reduced damage and Push immunity effects from certain patterns during the battle[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the HP of the Barrier of Subjugation in the Abyssal Space[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Kazeros Raid: Act 2[/p][list][*][p]Normal and Hard Difficulty[/p][list][*][p]Gate 2[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the damage of illusion orbs summoned by Brelshaza, Phantom Manifester[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Normal Difficulty[/p][list][*][p]Gate 1[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the damage of certain patterns used by Narok the Butcher[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the temperature recovery amount when using the exclusive battle item Flame Magic Scroll[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gate 2[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the damage of certain patterns used by Brelshaza, Phantom Manifester[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced the number of hits required to release a character trapped in Dream Prison[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the duration of the bar movement in the mini-game where players press the spacebar to stop it within the designated area[/p][/*][*][p]Being hit by the Dream Reaper no longer applies the Magick Afterimage debuff[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the HP of the Nightmare Pentacle[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hard Difficulty[/p][list][*][p]Gate 1 and 2[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the Boss HP and reduced the damage of Alliance Skills to match the lowered boss HP[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Mythic Desert Collection (Western Exclusive)[/h2][p]Unearth the power of the sands with the Mythic Desert Collection—a luxurious, ancient-inspired lineup that radiates mystique, majesty, and menace.[/p][list][*][p]Mythic Desert Skin Set A – Onyx Mythic Desert[/p][list][*][p]Drape yourself in flowing silks, ornate embroidery, and golden accents fit for a desert monarch. Set A evokes the nobility of ancient empires, blending elegance with ceremonial power.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/7zzCQXqaki69XReU8KFZmD/b47c4caff6334565381dc3e43e004438/LA_Mythic_Desert_Western_Exclusive_Skins_Images_Onyx_Male_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Mythic Desert Skin Set B – Quartz Mythic Desert[/p][list][*][p]Wield the fury of the sun with this armor-clad design. Set B features battle-scarred textures, dark metallic tones, and warrior silhouettes forged for heat-hardened champions of the wasteland.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/1HalUVsBIvtZz0Mk4ulW07/c6dc5e94e576e4e8a002e575eb1e3366/LA_Mythic_Desert_Western_Exclusive_Skins_Images_Quartz_Female_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Mythic Desert Weapon Skins – Twin Styles[/p][list][*][p]Channel sand and sun through weapons that match each set—ornate and gilded for the Dunewalkers, brutal and sun-bleached for the Warborn.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/68w5iO0w4uTbt1paZf03WH/b800ab2557760159991e8ac0056f7df9/LA_Mythic_Desert_Western_Exclusive_Skins_Images_Onyx_Weapon_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/7jULFSflzj2RrIfzu5Btg3/b130ad86ff5f9b07b3939fa420058dd5/LA_Mythic_Desert_Western_Exclusive_Skins_Images_Quartz_Weapon_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Mythic Desert Pets – Mystic Chameleons[/p][list][*][p]These bright-eyed, color-shifting companions are small in size but big on charm—each one a desert jewel in motion.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6mUzG8bQKB19jAPuyfWLKi/2383eccd17a94e49d1d427b172db6dc2/LA_Mythic_Desert_Western_Exclusive_Skins_Images_Pets_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Mythic Desert Mounts – Kingstrider[/p][list][*][p]Soar across the dunes on majestic gryphons adorned in vibrant desert plumage. Each variant embodies the spirit of shifting sands, starlit skies, or sun-scorched cliffs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/Af8HglxA3enxeNdBezxkH/07e27d96de474cc488607e179b1b782f/LA_Mythic_Desert_Western_Exclusive_Skins_Images_Mount2_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Mythic Desert Wallpaper – Chrome Sanctuary[/p][list][*][p]Transform your Character Selection Screen into a temple of timeworn glory. Golden light filters through massive pillars as the silhouette of a distant pyramid beckons.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6KMXTyRpVRZMhKIyMW6QYp/be6192a52500b30a61bbf66476022a7f/LA_Mythic_Desert_Western_Exclusive_Skins_Images_Wallpaper_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]GUARDIAN’S CALL EVENT[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/2s1ec0DKSYxpglImaZOfKe/8b42f628b133237d109c972770acb452/LA_May_Release_Note_Drextalas_Final_1920x1080_CT-000018742.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Earn valuable bonus materials from select Guardian Raids from June 25 to July 23. With random drops of Concentrated/Circulated Leapstones and Bound gold. Whether you’re preparing for the next tier or looking to boost your roster, this limited-time event adds extra incentive to your daily runs. How to Participate:[/p][list][*][p]Complete Guardian Raids during the event to receive additional rewards. Eligible Guardian Raids:[/p][list][*][p]Sonavel - Level: 1580 (T3)[/p][/*][*][p]Gargadeth - Level: 1600 (T3)[/p][/*][*][p]Veskal - Level: 1610 (T3)[/p][/*][*][p]Argeos - Level: 1640 (T4)[/p][/*][*][p]Skolakia - Level: 1680 (T4)[/p][/*][*][p]Drextalas - Level: 1700 (T4)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Earn ‘Concentrated’ and ‘Circulated Leapstones’ as guaranteed drops based on Guardian tier, but the amounts of each will vary.[/p][/*][*][p]If you’re lucky, you’ll also receive bonus Bound Gold drops, ranging from 5,000 to 20,000! notes.title: Team Update - Summer LOA ON & Roadmap News
notes.content: [p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/3bT5EGHStgXsUeK6kjMuii/fc21ef971d6340b7bc4ccc5de63e48c9/LA_Team_Update_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019266.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Heroes of Arkesia,[/p][p]This weekend, Smilegate RPG showed off the major updates, content, and future for Lost Ark. We’re excited to discuss the future of Lost Ark in the west, and are in the process of finalizing our next roadmap video. Join Lost Ark team members Roxx, Henry, and Matt for Part 3 of the 2025 Roadmap on July 1, with a full deep dive into all the content arriving in July, August, and September. It will also provide further discussions about other major pieces of content arriving throughout the rest of 2025— featuring some of the biggest news in LOA ON along with Western exclusive news. While the full video won’t be ready until July 1, we know the community wants to know when some critical pieces of content are arriving, so to hold you over until the video, here’s some topline spoilers for the next few months![/p][p][/p][h3][b]2025 Roadmap - Part 3 Teaser[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]July[/b][/p][p][b]Summer Update Gift[/b][/p][p]First off, we know the community is always excited about the LOA ON gift sent to players. The LOA ON gift will be granted to all players in the Western version of Lost Ark in July, as a summer gift celebrating the launch of Paradise, a system designed to help increase progression and add more casual solo activities for the global audience.[/p][p][b]New Progression System: Paradise[/b][/p][p]Launching in July, Paradise is a new seasonal solo progression system designed specifically for the global version of Lost Ark. Paradise helps players earn valuable rewards through three interconnected activities.[/p][p][b]Solo Mode & Mokoko Bootcamp[/b][/p][list][*][p]Solo Aegir joins the roster with an updated Tier 4 reward shop[/p][/*][*][p]Mokoko Bootcamp returns with:[/p][list][*][p]Aegir (Act 1) Hard Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Brelshaza (Act 2) Normal Mode[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life & System Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Skin Book System: Manage, preview, and craft all skins in a new streamlined interface—with the power increase system removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Una’s Task Overhaul: Dailies transition to weekly rewards after reputation completion, reducing daily grind[/p][/*][*][p]Balance Patch[/p][/*][*][p]Tripod & Epic Engraving Removal to simplify character systems[/p][/*][*][p]And many more QoL adjustments![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]August[/b][/p][p]The long-awaited female Paladin arrives in August! You’ll have to tune into the roadmap for the western name reveal. It will be accompanied by progression events to help new and existing players alike level up quickly. The Prestige Shop will also launch for players to exchange prestige points for some exciting new items.[/p][p][/p][p][b]September[/b][/p][p]The continent of Rimeria faces a new threat, as Abyssal Beasts have emerged. It’s up to you to stop them. For players familiar with this content in Korea, players often referred to it as the ‘Strike Raid’. The limited time event will be called Assault: Rimeria, in the West. This limited-time event includes two new playable activities:[/p][list][*][p]1–4 Player Event Dungeon[/p][/*][*][p]8-Player Endgame Event Raid[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope this tease was enough to hold you over until July 1. Join us then for the full roadmap diving further into each of these months, and some major moments arriving throughout the rest of the year. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia.[/p]

notes.title: Team Update - June 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/35SzHNct6fghTK0PS3RvQu/6bb37039954b546deeadea234687d9f2/LA_Blog_SS_09_1920.jpg[/img]
Heroes of Arkesia,

We wanted to provide an update on topics we discussed throughout our recent team video and some found within the latest Korean livestream. We will also be attempting to provide some clarity on other items we haven’t talked about yet. Three quick reminders before we dive in:
[list]
[*] If you haven’t watched the latest Team Update where Roxx, Matt, and Henry cover some major upcoming changes in the West you can find it [url=https://www.playlostark.com/news/articles/team-update-may-2025]here[/url]. It has a lot of context you’ll otherwise be missing! As this is a follow-up to that video, we will provide the context necessary for some items, but not at the same depth.
[*] We are striving to be as transparent as possible, but don’t want to share dates that could fluctuate this early in the process. To avoid disappointments, we will be sharing general timeframes in this article for the discussed items arriving after the June Update. The next roadmap will be releasing in early July, so if you’re wondering when some of these features will be releasing, make sure to tune in!
[*] Similar to the note above, many of these items are in active development, so you may see some changes throughout the process of bringing them to the West. We will share any major updates or changes with you as soon as we can. 
[/list]
[h2]June Update[/h2]

As June was on the previous roadmap, we wanted to share a few adjustments that will be included soon!

[h3]Raid Balance & Resurrection System for Kazeros Raids[/h3]

With the June monthly update arriving several weeks after the Act 3 raid, we will be implementing a resurrection system and decreasing the difficulty of several past raids (Behemoth, Echidna, Aegir, and Brelshaza). The June release notes will have full detailed descriptions for both the raid balance adjustments along with the resurrection system, but the quick summary is that each player will receive a single revive (per gate attempt), that can be used after dying to most things (excluding certain patterns or wipe mechanics). This will allow the first few weeks of the Frontier System to remain challenging for Act 3, but will ensure that all raids become more accessible for casual players and alternate characters. 

[h3]Stylebook & Stronghold Portrait Systems[/h3]

We’re excited to announce that the Stylebook feature will be arriving in the main June update at the end of the month. We’ll provide a full overview in the June release notes, but a quick summary of the Stylebook is that it’s a tool that allows players to upload screenshots of their outfits and style for other players to use as inspiration. Players can upvote various looks and favorite them to influence their own styles. We’re very interested to see who will emerge as style icons in the West.

Along with the Stylebook feature, new screenshot tools will become available, including a frame feature in the Stronghold where players can display their favorite screenshots. 

[h2]Summer 2025[/h2]

[h3]Mokoko Bootcamp[/h3]

While we saw a lot of positive feedback reinforcing the decision to tie Mokoko status to 10x Raid Clears, we also saw some player concerns about the system still having an Item Level cap after we shared the planned changes, so we wanted to share the planned level. When the Mokoko Bootcamp returns this summer with the adjustments, it will be extended to include Aegir (Act 1) Hardmode and Brelshaza (Act 2) Normal Mode. For these raids, we plan for the Item Level cap to be at 1689, so that players aren’t punished for continuing to progress after reaching the respective Item Levels for those raids at 1680 and 1670. We will continue to lookout for feedback on the system, and appreciate the feedback we’ve received so far!

[h3]Skin Collection Book[/h3]

Quick context; it’s a feature that allows for a more organized cosmetic collection and expands the number of available slots to stash cosmetics in your inventory. This will release alongside the Paradise system this summer, without the power increase and ranking systems found within other versions of Lost Ark. We hope this is a helpful tool for expanding the closets of Arkesian fashionistas, but don’t want there to be additional pressure to collect every skin. 

[h3]Una’s Task Improvements[/h3]

In the last player survey, we had specific questions about your thoughts on dailies. The feedback provided by you, the Lost Ark Community, helped us during discussions about changes for the Western version of the game. As a direct result, we are very excited to bring the following change to the West.

Daily Una’s Tasks will be improved to help balance the amount of daily/weekly ‘homework’ activity when the Paradise system is added into the game. Daily tasks will remain, but once the reputation milestones are reached, the tasks will disappear. Daily Una’s rewards will be moved to weekly quest rewards. 

[h3]General QoL[/h3]

Throughout the summer we plan to implement a variety of upcoming QoL changes; everything from removing Tripod Levels & Epic Engravings to improving the support experience. 

Two QoL systems we haven’t discussed previously are the Battle Analyzer feature (a feature that displays the player’s battle performance to themselves) and the Comprehensive Battle Score (a form of Gear Score that factors in a variety of power vectors). For these systems, we’re excited to implement as we believe that they will help players better understand their contributions on the battlefield, but will be on the lookout for toxicity created by these systems. We hope that other changes will help mitigate gatekeeping and toxicity, such as the updates to Mokoko Bootcamp, raid difficulty decreases, and the Kazeros Raid resurrection system.

We're still evaluating the Bound Gem changes for the Western release, and are aiming to have a further update in the next Roadmap.

[h3]Mileage Shop[/h3]

Our policy for the Mileage Shop will be providing 10% of Royal Crystals spent through the in-game shop as “Prestige Points”, which can be exchanged for a variety of rewards in the Mileage Shop. It’s important to note that Prestige Points are not awarded for Steam DLC or MTX items, or for items purchased with Crystals. This will also retroactively apply to past Royal Crystal expenditures. We are currently targeting August for the full release of the Mileage Shop.

[h3]API[/h3]

Our team hit some delays in releasing the feature from when we initially stated we were looking into releasing it in the West, but we are still actively investigating the path forward. We know it can be frustrating for those who were eagerly anticipating its arrival, but didn’t want to remain silent on the topic when we know it’s important to various players, content creators, and fan sites. We will continue to work on this behind the scenes, and will provide a more concrete update when we’re able to.

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]

We have a lot of exciting content on the horizon, with Act 3 arriving shortly, another big update later in June, followed by the roadmap in early July to share the future of content of Lost Ark. As always, thank you for your passion, feedback, and support— it’s been critical in helping us shape the future of Arkesia. With a multitude of new systems and pieces of content on the horizon, some of which are being designed for the global verison of Lost Ark, your feedback and passion will continue to be essential. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia.

notes.title: Addressing Community Feedback and Anticipated Changes
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/35SzHNct6fghTK0PS3RvQu/6bb37039954b546deeadea234687d9f2/LA_Blog_SS_09_1920.jpg[/img]
[h2]Heroes of Arkesia,[/h2]

Following the recent Korean Live Stream, we know many of you have questions about how these announcements will impact the Western version of the game. To ensure transparency and avoid speculation, we want to clarify what you can expect based on our internal discussions. 


[h3]Nerfs and Endgame Balance[/h3]

While Smilegate RPG has announced gold adjustments to various raid levels in the Korean version, our region's economy and gold income are not 1:1. 

We understand concerns about implementing certain nerfs at this stage. Doing so now could negatively impact the experience for both new and returning players, as well as endgame players who are still progressing. Since we are behind the Korean version in terms of how long these raids have been available, we want to carefully consider any gold balance changes to ensure they don’t disrupt progression or overall gameplay experience. We will continue to monitor this closely and provide updates as needed.

However, to ease progression costs for new and returning players, we will be implementing the Transcendence and Advanced Honing nerfs. These changes will help make progression more accessible without the negative impact that gold nerfs might have caused. These will be reflected in the April update and are as follows: 


Advanced Honing
[list]
[*] Required shards and silver -20% for Tempering stage 1 and 2
[*] Required honing materials -50% to progress Advanced honing level 1 - 20
[*] Required Shards, Silver and Gold -20% for Advanced honing level 1 - 20
[/list]
Armor Transcendence
[list]
[*] Restoration 740 Gold > 510 Gold
[*] Purification 110 Gold > 75 Gold
[/list]
Weapon Transcendence 
[list]
[*] Restoration 2,200 Gold > 1,460 Gold
[*] Purification 190 Gold > 125 Gold
[/list]

[h3]Gem System Adjustments[/h3]

We recognize that the current gem system creates barriers to both character progression and playstyle flexibility. Our goal is to create an environment where players can freely enjoy their favorite classes without unnecessary restrictions.

While some players choose to play multiple characters of the same class for fun, others choose to optimize gem usage, our focus is on promoting a healthy balance where players feel free to explore classes based on what they find most enjoyable. We will continue to evaluate ways to support greater class diversity and player choice.

Smilegate RPG is actively exploring solutions to make the gem system more flexible. We are carefully evaluating multiple options, each with its own pros and cons, to find the best path forward. This process takes time, and we appreciate your patience as we work toward a balanced solution. We’ve said it many times before, but your feedback is invaluable to us. While we may not respond to every social post, we are always listening, actively discussing player concerns, and considering both data and community input in our decisions. Your passion and dedication help shape the game, and we encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts in constructive discussions.


[h3]Class Balance Patch[/h3]

Class balance is vital to maintaining a fair and engaging gameplay experience, and we take it very seriously. We always strive to bring the latest class balance updates to the Western version as soon as possible. Smilegate RPG’s recent balance patch will be applied in the West’s April update, bringing several important class adjustments. We appreciate your patience as we finalize specifics for the Western version and will continue to share updates as they become available.


[h3]Content Localization Updates[/h3]

As our game has evolved, we've significantly narrowed the gap with the Korean version. Initially, the well-defined two year roadmap allowed ample time for localizing new continents, raids, in-game guides, and other content across multiple languages. However, as we've got closer to the Korean updates, we've seen increased demand on localization. After careful analysis of player language preferences, we've discovered that German and French localizations are currently being utilized by a much smaller portion of our community than anticipated.

Therefore, beginning with the May update, we will cease supporting German and French localizations and reallocate resources to the remaining languages to support the increased localization demand. The game will transition to English voice-over and text for players who previously selected German or French. Moving forward, we will be focusing our localization efforts on English and Spanish support. Our website will also reflect this change for a consistent experience across all platforms, with the in-game translations being supported on the site. You will see these changes take place throughout April.  We continue to evaluate our localization strategy and appreciate your understanding as we work to deliver timely content updates.

[h3]Bus Advertising[/h3]

We’ve noticed players using creative methods to advertise bus services, such as making their titles appear unrelated to the actual activity (e.g., using terms like “Field Trip” or “Journey”) and using passwords to indirectly advertise prices. This behavior undermines our no-advertising policy, and we are actively working to eliminate this practice to maintain the integrity of the in-game economy and community. The grace period for shorter bans has now passed, and players who continue to break this policy will face escalating penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in keeping the game fair and enjoyable for everyone.


[h3]T3 Deadzone[/h3]

The T3 honing dead zone (1580 - 1620) is a known progression pain point and is not something that's new to the Western Version of the game. We are actively working on addressing this. At the moment, we are not able to share the exact plans we have to address this, but we felt it was important to at least call this out. In the meantime, we will continue to support rosters that are challenged by this dead zone, with more materials and books through the various events we have planned.

[h3]Looking Ahead[/h3]

We understand that many of these changes will have a significant impact on the game’s progression and community dynamics. We are committed to keeping you informed as we implement these updates and are actively working to ensure that these changes are positive for both new and experienced players.

Thank you for your continued support, and we’re excited to continue this journey with you. We’ll see you in Arkesia!

notes.title: Lost Ark 2025 Roadmap – Part 2
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/1fuBvxSJhdAiZDWttFdPai/7b4bda2cfe4530da9fccab0ffe5f1e0c/LA_Roadmap_April-June_25_Part_2_1920x1080_CT-000017468.jpg[/img]
[h2]Greetings, Heroes of Arkesia![/h2]

We’re back with the second part of the 2025 Lost Ark Roadmap, covering the exciting months ahead. Watch Roxx (Senior Product Community Manager), Matt (Associate Franchise Lead) and Henry (Head of Editorial) talk through what’s coming to Lost Ark from April through June. 

[previewyoutube=YLDVaJFVGCk;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, since Lost Ark is a live-service game, plans may shift, but we’re excited to reveal what’s ahead! The roadmap content discussed are highlights we know players are eagerly awaiting, but the roadmap is not a comprehensive list of every change arriving in Arkesia over the next few months, and could change. As we approach each month, more details will be shared. Stay tuned to our website and social channels for future Release Notes, including the full list of new content, cosmetics, content balance changes, events, and more included in our major monthly updates.

[h3]April[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/2jZIqcsYfIDw0dwUuQIFfB/a36a3fef466b89bc3ae38550ad6ccc73/LA_Roadmap_April_KeyArt_1920x1080_CT.jpg[/img]

[b]Progression Events[/b]
April will focus on preparing players for the upcoming Kazeros Raid. To help with that, two major progression events are launching. These will provide materials for character progression and ensure players are geared up for the challenges ahead.
[list]
[*] Storm the Abyss Event
[*] Road to Act 3 Event
[/list]

[b]Base Build Update[/b]
A new base build update will bring significant quality-of-life improvements. Some of the most important and impactful changes include:

 [b]Balance Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Per-gate reward details for better visibility.
[*] No penalties for leaving Ebony Cube and Guardian Raids when playing solo.
[*] Boss shield damage now included in MVP screen calculations.
[*] Attack patterns that pull or push your character will slow down when using skills.
[*] Stronghold “Like” buttons added to show appreciation for visited strongholds.
[/list]
The full list of details will be shared in the April release notes later this month!

[b]Ark Pass: Roses & Frost[/b]
The Roses and Frost Ark Pass arrives in April, bringing:
[list]
[*] Free and paid tracks with progression materials, and more.
[*] The paid track features the Roses and Frost skin set, a new pet, and a mount.
[/list]
[h3]May[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6s62eZm3BE3rTL9uavyRuo/c8b4fc1157d480a819b2364552df3335/LA_Roadmap_May_KeyArt_1920x1080_CT.jpg[/img]
[b]New Continent - Rimeria[/b]
May introduces Rimeria, homeland of the Yoz, known as “The Land That Guards the Dawn.” Once a place of great sacrifice, Rimeria now faces the return of Kazeros’ influence as new Rifts emerge. Player need to help Shandi and the Rimeria Elders to protect the land. This new continent brings:
[list]
[*] A continuation of the Main Story Quest
[*] New Adventurer’s Tome
[*] Rapport NPCs
[*] Side quests, achievements, collections, and new rewards
[/list]
[b]Additional Content Unlocks (Item Level 1700+)[/b]
[list]
[*] Kurzan Front Operation – Earn T4 Ancient Accessories and Cube Unlock 3 Tickets.
[*] New Cube Tier – Available through stronghold dispatch missions, guild bloodstones, and more.
[*] New Guardian Raid: Drextalas – A blue-flamed beast drops Ancient Bracelets and new cards/card sets.
[*] Chaos Gate Update – A new level with a chance to obtain a Relic Book if a rare boss spawns.
[*] Fate Embers Update – Now have a chance to drop Relic Books from the 1700 Guardian Raids and Kurzan Frontline.
[/list]
[b]Kazeros Raid Act 3 Prelude[/b]
Kazeros Raid Act 3 launches two weeks after the May update. After adventures in Rimeria, signs of Armen will lead players back to North Kurzan, where the alliance gathers at Storm Tower.

[b]K-Pop Skins[/b]
May isn’t all about battle— K-Pop-themed skins are coming! If you’ve ever wanted to dress like an idol, now’s your chance.

[h3]June Part 1[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/iyZIAyL1ucpzt1Mi4eEER/f4f309758431815f25acfae8cdea9374/LA_Roadmap_June_KeyArt_1920x1080_CT.jpg[/img]

[b]Kazeros Raid Act 3[/b]
The war escalates as players take on the Kazeros Raid Act 3, an 8-player, 3-gate raid with Normal and Hard difficulties. New and old foes will need to be vanquished. Call upon legendary heroes with Allied Forces skills like Thirain, Nineveh, Bastion, Balthorr, and even… Kharmine? The Act 3 Raid will release in early June, two weeks after the release of Rimeria. 
Normal Mode (Item Level 1680)
[list]
[*] Hard Mode (Item Level 1700) will start from Frontier Mode Stage 3 (Explorer) and gradually ease to Stage 0 (Adventurer) over time.
[*] Frontier Mode Stage 0 (Adventurer) will be applied immediately to Normal Mode upon release.
[/list]
Bosses Include:
[list]
[*] Thaemine – An epic rematch.
[*] Chaos Guardian Naitreya – A formidable new foe.
[*] Mordum, the Abyssal Punisher – A massive threat to Arkesia.
[/list]
Raid Rewards:
[list]
[*] Thundercrack Horns (Normal) for Advanced Honing Stage 3.
[*] Thunder Orbs (Hard) for Stages 3 & 4 (raising the total Item Level cap by 20).
[*] Relic-grade engraving books and a new winged mount.
[/list]
[h3]June Part 2[/h3]
[b]Kazeros Raid Act 3 Postlude[/b]
After defeating Mordum, a Postlude quest will wrap up this phase of the story… but the war against Kazeros isn’t finished yet.

[b]Western Exclusive Skins[/b]
New Western-exclusive skins are launching in May, inspired by ancient deserts, along with:
[list]
[*] A Horus-inspired mount.
[*] A cute desert lizard pet
[/list]
[b]Yornujan Island[/b]
Get ready to set sail—Yornujan Island is making its debut in June. This mysterious island near Rimeria is home to young Yoz in training, and they need your help to hone their skills.

What Awaits You on Yornujan Island?
[list]
[*] An Intriguing Story — The young Yoz still need your help! Visit the island to assist with their training and help them create stronger illusions.
[*] A New Daily Quest – Lend a hand in training the young Yoz and prove your worth.
[*] Exciting Rewards – Complete quests to earn valuable treasures and claim the coveted Island Soul.
[/list]
Prepare to explore, train, and earn exclusive rewards when Yornujan Island opens its shores this June!

[h3]Looking Ahead[/h3]
Summer is heating up, and while Mordum will be a massive challenge, there’s even more on the horizon. How about something with a big sword and a holy aura?

When we reveal the next roadmap, you’ll get a sneak peek at exciting updates we’ve been working on. We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and later this summer, we’ll be rolling out more surprises that you won’t want to miss. Get ready for what’s next after conquering the Act 3 raid! Stay tuned!

[h3]Exclusive Offer: A Special Gift Just for You![/h3]
As a special thank you for your continued support, use the code ROADMAPTWO on our [url=https://www.playlostark.com/en-us/community/code-redemption]website[/url] to claim a free gift. But don’t wait too long – this exclusive offer is only available until 4/10 at 12am PST / 7am UTC.

We’ll see you in Arkesia!
